sections.title: 1 Introduction
sections.text_preview: This section provides an overview of this project.

sections.title: 1.1 Purpose
sections.text_preview: The purpose of this document is to describe functionality and behavior of the new agentMom framework. This document is intended to be viewed only by project advisor and committee members.

sections.title: 1.2 Scope
sections.text_preview: This document covers the software requirements for the project “Applying Broadcasting/Multicasting/Secured Communication to agentMom in Multi-Agent Systems”.
